7.3.3.5.5.2 Operations – Query for executions of an operation
The SOVD server allows multiple parallel executed operations. Each operation is as-
signed to a unique identifier at runtime. The
query for executions of an op-
eration
returns active execution identifiers to the SOVD client.
[SWS_DM_01394] Support of
SOVD
method
Query for executions of an
operation
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04260, RS_Diag_04258
⌈
For each SOVD operation supporting
asynchronous_execution
, the
Diagnos-
tic Server instance
shall support the SOVD method
Query for executions
of an operation
according to ASAM SOVD[5][14].
⌋
[SWS_DM_02170] Retrieval of
SOVD
entity executions of an
operation
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262, RS_Diag_04258
⌈
If the SOVD method
Query for executions of an operation
is received,
the DM shall send a response body according to ASAM SOVD[5][14] and add for
each available
DiagnosticSovdOperation
, a SOVD
OperationDescription
item string with the dynamically assigned
execution-id
from [SWS_DM_02177] to
that operation.
⌋
7.3.3.5.5.3 Operations – Proximity Management
The ASAM SOVD standard[5][14] uses the
proximity_proof
method to ensure, that
certain
operations
are executed only, in case a supervising person (e.g. technician)
is physically present at the vehicle, while an
operation
is executed.
These operations have
DiagnosticSovdOperation.proximityProofRequired
set to
TRUE
.

proximity_proof
, the interface
ara::diag::SovdProximity-
Challenge
